vendor/rete-bundle.js contiene:
- PeerJS 1.5.5 (https://peerjs.com) - licenza MIT
- jsQR 1.4.0 (https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR) - licenza Apache 2.0
- qrcode-generator 1.4.4 (https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator) - licenza MIT
Generato con esbuild (entry.js --bundle --format=esm --minify), vedi strumenti/bundle-rete.
